recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5831 unless a future work-group issue reopens EpisodeOfCare status naming.
issue_request: FHIR-5831 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core PA change request raised against DSTU1 EpisodeOfCare requesting that EpisodeOfCare.currentStatus be renamed to EpisodeOfCare.status because statusHistory did not make the conventional status element name unclear. The Jira resolution states that currentStatus was updated to status as requested.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5831 or Tracker# 5831 commit subject was found. The historical application appears in f659c3fbc16870414aac80f798d75afcb5480bf8, a 2015 EpisodeOfCare ballot reconciliation commit that changed the example from <currentStatus> to <status> and changed the spreadsheet path from EpisodeOfCare.currentStatus to EpisodeOfCare.status; source/history.html also records the rename.
additional_context: EpisodeOfCare is active in current build scope through source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition, example, status search parameter, and status-code support files consistently use EpisodeOfCare.status while retaining statusHistory as a separate element. Current-source grep found no currentStatus under source/episodeofcare, and remaining currentStatus matches are historical text or unrelated Action.currentStatus mappings on other resources. Related status-code issues FHIR-5833 and FHIR-5834 are already represented on the combined branch by separate audit commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the authoritative current source already implements the requested rename.
